description: Greater Dublin Area Cycle Infrastructure is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Transport Authority. This dataset contains cycle infrastructure in the Greater Dublin Area (GDA). Data stems from work undertaken on behalf of the NTA to: re-categorise the 2013 street survey with infrastructure types: segregated cycle track, bus lane with cycle lane, etc. Coverage: Ireland. The portal files it under the publisher National Transport Authority. Its tags are Cycle Lanes, Cycleways, Dublin, Dun Laoghaire-Rathdown, Fingal. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, DB_TABLE, DOCX, KML, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
